changelog:
- Initial release of the audio-transcription skill.
- Transcribes audio files (OGG, MP3, WAV, M4A, and others with auto-conversion) to text using Whisper locally or via API.
- Supports multiple languages with automatic language detection.
- Flexible backend selection: prefers local Whisper, then whisper.cpp, then OpenAI API.
- Includes a convenient shell script for easy audio transcription.
- Handles Telegram OGG files and outlines simple dependency installation steps.
